page.overview:
Who is City Spider?

The City Spider is the only cellar-spider-like character and is one of the minor characters in A Bug's Life.

The City Spider appears to be a rust-colored harvestman. His face is not seen in the movie, but on the movie posters, his face is seen, and it appears to be a smiling face.

"Everything seems faster, louder, and bigger in the city. As Flik stands gazing at the hubbub in the streets before him, an enormous daddy long legs stalks past, dwarfing everything including Flik, who is totally awed."
